request.goal: Find member {{memberId}} and retrieve their current account balance. Confirm the member ID and account type. Return the balance, account type, and member ID.

memberId.description: Member ID observed in the result

accountType.description: Current account type displayed for the member

balance.description: Current account balance displayed for the member
